# A Canadian company that borrows 100.00 USD, records it as 130.00 CAD owed,
# and later earns the US dollars it will repay with.
#
# Nothing stops a book being kept this way, and it is a reasonable thing for a
# Canadian company to do: the loan is written in the book's own currency at
# what it was worth the day it was drawn, and the liability account holds no
# US dollars at all.
#
# What that costs is the point of this fixture. A liability denominated in CAD
# holds no foreign currency, so it opens no cost basis and the balance sheet
# states no unrealized figure for it — while the loan is outstanding the
# exposure is invisible to the sheet. It does not go away. It arrives when the
# debt is settled, against what the US dollars used to settle it cost.
#
# The dollars do not have to be bought. A company that invoices US customers
# earns them, and what it earns carries a cost basis like anything else.
#
# - 2026-01-02  1,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2026-01-03  100.00 USD borrowed, recorded as 130.00 CAD owed. No account
#               in this book holds a US dollar yet, so nothing opens a cost
#               basis and nothing on the sheet says the debt is foreign.
# - 2026-09-01  100.00 USD of consulting collected into a US dollar account
#               with the dollar at 1.40, so 140.00 CAD of revenue is
#               recognised and that split opens a cost basis of 100.00 USD.
#
# Drawn here, the sheet states 100.00 USD held at what it cost and a 130.00
# CAD liability that never moves. The repayment is in
# `the_us_loan_repaid_with_earned_us_dollars.txt`.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: "Liability"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:US Loan
	type: "Liability"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening balances
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Consulting
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Foreign exchange loss
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-03 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "13/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-09-01 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "14/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 1000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening balances -1000.00 CAD

2026-01-03 * "Borrow 100.00 USD, recorded as 130.00 CAD owed"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 130.00 CAD
	Liabilities:US Loan -130.00 CAD

2026-09-01 * "Consulting collected, 100.00 USD at 1.40"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 100.00 USD
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "140.00"
	Income:Consulting -140.00 CAD
